summary: Global-E Online Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release reporting Q2 2026 financial results and raising full-year guidance. GMV rose 44% YoY to $2,089 million; revenue increased 39% to $299.0 million; Adjusted EBITDA margin expanded 300 bps to 20.9%. The press release includes U.S. GAAP financial statements incorporated by reference into an existing Form S-8. No M&A, strategic transaction, or other special situation is announced. The filing is a routine earnings report by an operating company. As such, it does not represent a special-situation event requiring event-driven analysis.
